title: Add Czech (cs_CZ.UTF-8) translation
body:
## Summary

This PR adds complete Czech language support for Ghostty based on #6840 by @calamitywoah, with improvements from community review feedback.

## Changes

- **Translation file**: Added `po/cs_CZ.UTF-8.po` with all 60 UI strings translated to Czech
- **Locale registration**: Added `cs_CZ.UTF-8` to `src/os/i18n_locales.zig`

## Translation Improvements

Based on feedback from #6840 reviewers (@ambrozf, @deepj, @Maneren, @pluiedev), the following improvements were applied:

1. **Terminal Title**: Uses "název" (title) instead of "nadpis" (heading) for better accuracy
2. **Split Directions**: Uses directional adverbs (nahoru/dolů/doleva/doprava) instead of locative case for more natural commands
3. **Natural Phrasing**: "Ponechte prázdné" instead of overly formal "Zanechte prázdné"
4. **Consistent Formality**: "Zapamatovat volbu" (formal infinitive) instead of informal "Zapamatuj si volbu"
5. **Proper Czech Terminology**: "ladicí verzi" instead of the anglicism "debugovací verzi"

## Credits

- Original translation: Luna (@calamitywoah)
- Review contributions: @ambrozf, @deepj, @Maneren, @pluiedev
- Additional improvements and locale registration: @tkudlicka

## References

Closes #6840
